items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tal Farlow. Name some hell of a guitar players.

ctx.x: So I’m in Cab’s band. So they get the word. They ask Cab, “What do you think?” “He’s all right. He’s all right. He’s all right.” Well I was with [? (inaudible)]. I was with Benny Carter’s band. Benny Carter’s band was a triumphant band. When you worked with Benny Carter, [expletive deleted]. Everybody, they didn’t speak to you before, speak to you, because you’re with Benny Carter. Benny Carter had heard me and Johnny Williams and Walter Johnson. I don’t know why he didn’t hire, because Walter Johnson was . . .…
